description: This header file defines function prototypes and includes related to the lu5 core runtime, including initialization, setup, animation frame updates, and cleanup for a WebAssembly module.

methods.name: lu5_get_handle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the current lu5_State instance.

methods.name: lu5_run_sketch
methods.description: Sets up the runtime environment with a specified filename and source code.

methods.name: lu5_animation_frame
methods.description: Updates the animation frame, advancing the state based on delta_time.

methods.name: lu5_close
methods.description: Cleans up and closes the given lu5_State instance.
